check_events.outcome: For a group extension p:E→Q and section σ:Q→E, restriction to a subgroup N⊂Q gives σ_N(n)=(σ(n),n) in E×_Q N. Since p(σ(n))=n, this lies in the pullback and is a homomorphism splitting its projection to N. Thus the claimed section of the subextension follows formally once that subextension is the pullback along N_{s\prime}.
